name: bridge-tool-drift
title: Detect drift between the generated Pi tools and the subagent bridge
description: Close the residual R10 risk left by 09-13-pi-subagents-dispatch: the bridge hard-codes the single shipped tool name, so a Trellis upgrade that renames it or registers another dispatch tool silently ends the deactivation and the competing guidance returns. Add drift detection plus a tool list in the bridge, without editing any generated file.
